objects.name: Credential Harvesting Activity on windows-server-
objects.description:
While hunting for advanced threats, Mandiant identified evidence of credential harvesting on `windows-server-` occuring on January 5, 2024 at 06:55:08 UTC. At that time, Mandiant identified `powershell.exe` executing command-line arguments designed to download and execute a `MIMIKATZ` PowerShell script.

This activity was identified when hunting for the missions MITRE ATT&CK Technique T1059.001: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell.

### About MIMIKATZ
The Mimikatz Credential Harvesting Utility is publicly available and capable of process injection, SAM hash dumping, exporting certificates, and private keys. This utility is occasionally used by system administrators to evaluate security measures, however Mandiant has observed advanced attackers using Mimikatz for malicious purposes in several previous investigations.

For further information, see the following link(s):

https://advantage.mandiant.com/reports/17-00001506

### About T1059.001: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell 
Threat actors may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution. PowerShell is a powerful interactive command-line interface and scripting environment included in the Windows operating system. Threat actors can use PowerShell to perform a number of actions, including discovery of information and execution of code. Examples include the `Start-Process` cmdlet which can be used to run an executable and the `Invoke-Command` cmdlet which runs a command locally or on a remote computer.
